title: calamagrostis corsica
intro: Calamagrostis corsica, commonly known as Corsican bentgrass, is a perennial grass species native to the island of Corsica. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calamagrostis corsica may include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that may contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and benefits of using Calamagrostis corsica as a medicinal plant.
